verdict.rationale: Qodo's code review docs say you can discuss or dismiss a finding 'or let Qodo apply the fix directly,' and each finding includes how to fix it. In-PR chat adds a way to act on findings without leaving the pull request. The Agentic Toolbox plugins and MCP also let coding agents retrieve and resolve findings as an agent-driven follow-up, though from the agent rather than the PR. Missing for 10: detail on how the applied fix is committed to the PR branch (commit or suggestion mechanics), documentation of an agent-generated follow-up triggered from within the PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
